변경 이유: 진단의 지시 1과 4에 따라, 회피 트리거에 가장 가까운 물체까지의 거리 조건(d_near < 1.5 m)을 기존 TTC·근접 조건과 OR 로 묶어 넣었고, `_TTC_TRIG` 를 0.5 s 로 낮췄습니다. 거리만으로 켜진 트리거는 종료 판정 창을 초기화하지 않으므로, 물체가 1.5 m 안에 머물러도 회피가 끝없이 이어지지 않습니다. 지시 2, 3, 6에 따라 회피 중 후보 선택(`_choose`, `_narrow_lateral`, `_no_spin`)은 예측 정적 여유 stc ≥ 0.1 m 를 필수로 했고, 이를 만족하는 후보가 없으면 정적 여유가 가장 큰 후보군 안에서 고르도록 했습니다. 이때 점수의 물체 여유와 정적 여유 가중치는 20:40(1:2, 둘 다 1 m 상한)이며, 회피 중 현재 정적 여유가 0.1 m 미만이면 정적 우선 모드를 다시 켭니다. 지시 5에 따라 회피의 정상 종료(거리 증가, 정지 물체, 물체 후퇴)에는 현재 정적 여유 ≥ 0.1 m 가 0.5 s 이어져야 한다는 조건을 더했고, 강제 종료(3 s 상한, 협소 구간 상한)는 그대로 두어 회피가 무한히 길어지지 않게 했습니다.

```python
_TTC_TRIG = 0.5         # attempt 24 / direction 4: evasion triggers when TTC < 0.5 s (was 1.0 s)


_NEAR_TRIG_D = 1.5      # attempt 24 / direction 1: nearest mover closer than this [m] also triggers evasion (OR with TTC / proximity)


_EV_ST_HARD = 0.1       # attempt 24 / directions 2, 3: evasion candidates must keep predicted static clearance >= this [m]


_EV_ST_FALL_TOL = 0.05  # attempt 24 / direction 3: static-first fallback keeps candidates within this [m] of the best stc


_EV_END_ST = 0.1        # attempt 24 / direction 5: current static clearance [m] required to end evasion normally


_EV_END_ST_S = 0.5      # attempt 24 / direction 5: _EV_END_ST must hold this long [s] before a normal evasion end


_EV_MV_SC_W = 20.0      # attempt 24 / direction 6: evasion score weight per m of mover clearance (capped at _EV_SC_CAP)


_EV_ST_SC_W = 40.0      # attempt 24 / direction 6: evasion score weight per m of static clearance (mover : static = 1 : 2)


_EV_SC_CAP = 1.0        # attempt 24 / direction 6: both clearance terms are capped at this [m]


def controller(t, pose, env):
    """Waypoint law + 2D-lidar mover handling (attempt 24):
    - direction 1: evasion also triggers when the nearest mover is closer than _NEAR_TRIG_D (1.5 m), OR-ed with the
      TTC / proximity-approach triggers; a distance-only trigger does not reset the evasion-end windows
    - direction 4: _TTC_TRIG = 0.5 s
    - directions 2, 3, 6: evasion candidates need stc >= _EV_ST_HARD (0.1 m), static-first fallback otherwise,
      mover : static clearance weights 1 : 2 (in _choose / _narrow_lateral); st0 < 0.1 m during evasion -> static priority
    - direction 5: a normal evasion end additionally needs st0 >= _EV_END_ST (0.1 m) held for _EV_END_ST_S (0.5 s)
    - all other logic and parameters unchanged from attempt 23"""
    S = _CS
    if not S:
        S.update(idx=0, tracks=[], mv={"front": np.zeros((0, 2)), "back": np.zeros((0, 2))},
                 mt={"front": -99.0, "back": -99.0}, last={}, v=0.0, w=0.0,
                 slow=False, stopped=False, n_stop=0, stop_t=0.0, stop_sum=0.0,
                 started=False, reported=False,
                 evading=False, ev_logged=False, evade_until=-1.0, n_evade=0, evade_t=0.0, evade_sum=0.0,
                 evade_on=False, evade_start=0.0, cool_until=-1.0, st_prio=False,
                 d_samp=9.0, samp_t=-99.0, inc_since=-1.0, inc_d0=9.0, stat_since=-1.0, stat_d0=9.0,
                 away_since=-1.0, n_force=0, narrow_end=-1.0, n_prox=0,
                 stall_since=-1.0, stall_d0=9.0, retry_until=-1.0, n_retry=0, n_app=0,
                 st_ok_since=-1.0, n_near=0)
    x, y, yaw = pose
    n = len(_WAYPOINTS)

    # 1) sensing: both 2D lidars -> world points -> drop static map -> mover clusters/tracks
    fresh = {}
    for which in ("front", "back"):
        p = lidar2d_points(which)
        if p.shape[0] > 0 and p is not S["last"].get(which):
            S["last"][which] = p
            S["mv"][which] = _ingest(p, pose, abs(S["w"]))
            S["mt"][which] = t
            fresh[which] = True
    if fresh.get("front") or (fresh.get("back") and t - S["mt"]["front"] > 0.25):
        parts = [S["mv"][k] for k in ("front", "back") if t - S["mt"][k] < 0.25]
        _update_tracks(np.concatenate(parts) if parts else np.zeros((0, 2)), t)

    if not S["started"]:   # look before the first move (a mover may be near START)
        if not ((S["mt"]["front"] > -1.0 and t >= 0.3) or t >= 2.0):
            return 0.0, 0.0, False
        S["started"] = True

    # 2) goal alignment / finish
    if S["idx"] >= n and math.hypot(GOAL[0] - x, GOAL[1] - y) > 0.5:
        S["idx"] = n - 1
    if S["idx"] >= n and abs(_wrap_angle(GOAL[2] - yaw)) < 0.05:
        _log_stop(t, pose, False, 9.0)
        _log_evade(t, pose, False, 99.0, 9.0)
        if not S["reported"]:
            S["reported"] = True
            print("[C2 debug] done t=%.2f stop_episodes=%d stopped_total=%.2fs evade_episodes=%d evade_total=%.2fs "
                  "forced_ends=%d prox_triggers=%d near_triggers=%d stall_retries=%d approach_escapes=%d"
                  % (t, S["n_stop"], S["stop_sum"], S["n_evade"], S["evade_sum"], S["n_force"], S["n_prox"],
                     S["n_near"], S["n_retry"], S["n_app"]),
                  flush=True)
        return 0.0, 0.0, True

    # 3) nominal command (verified law) and its predicted safety against ALL movers
    v_n, w_n, S["idx"] = _nominal_cmd(x, y, yaw, S["idx"], 1.0)
    target = _WAYPOINTS[min(S["idx"], n - 1)]
    P, U = _movers_now(t)

    d_near = _nearest_mover(P, pose)
    ttc = _ttc(P, U, pose, S["v"], _EARLY_R)
    anchors = _mover_anchors(t, pose)

    app_rel = -_closing_speed(P, U, pose, S["v"], _PROX_D)   # >0: approaching (robot motion included)
    app_own = -_closing_speed(P, U, pose, 0.0, _PROX_D)      # >0: the mover itself approaches
    prox = d_near < _PROX_D and app_rel > _PROX_V
    hard = d_near < _EV_STOP_HARD and app_rel > _PROX_V

    traj_n = _rollout_nominal(pose, S["idx"], S["v"], 1.0)
    st_n = _static_clearance(traj_n[None, :_KS + 1])[0]
    clr_all = _mover_clearance(traj_n[None], P, U)[0]
    st0 = _pose_static_clearance(pose)
    narrow = st_n < _EV_TRIG_ST

    # evasion trigger: TTC or proximity-approach (danger) OR absolute distance (attempt 24 / direction 1)
    danger = ttc < _TTC_TRIG or prox
    near_abs = d_near < _NEAR_TRIG_D
    if (danger or near_abs) and (t >= S["cool_until"] or clr_all < _CLR_GO or hard):
        if not S["evade_on"]:
            S["evade_on"] = True
            S["evade_start"] = t
            S["evade_until"] = t
            S["narrow_end"] = -1.0
            S["st_ok_since"] = -1.0
            S["st_prio"] = st0 < _ST_PRIO
            if prox and ttc >= _TTC_TRIG:
                S["n_prox"] += 1
                print("[C2 debug] prox trigger #%d t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f app=%.2f ttc=%.2f"
                      % (S["n_prox"], t, x, y, d_near, app_rel, ttc), flush=True)
            elif not danger:
                S["n_near"] += 1
                print("[C2 debug] near trigger #%d t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f ttc=%.2f"
                      % (S["n_near"], t, x, y, d_near, ttc), flush=True)
        S["evading"] = True
        if narrow and S["narrow_end"] < 0.0:
            S["narrow_end"] = t + _EV_NARROW_CAP
        cap = S["evade_start"] + _EVADE_MAX
        if S["narrow_end"] >= 0.0:
            cap = min(cap, S["narrow_end"])
        S["evade_until"] = min(max(S["evade_until"], t + _EVADE_HOLD), cap)
        if danger:   # a distance-only trigger keeps the end windows running (no endless evasion near a slow mover)
            S["inc_since"] = -1.0
            S["stat_since"] = -1.0
            S["away_since"] = -1.0
    sample = t - S["samp_t"] >= _EV_SAMP_DT - 1e-9
    if S["evade_on"]:
        # attempt 24 / direction 5: current static clearance >= _EV_END_ST held for _EV_END_ST_S
        if st0 >= _EV_END_ST:
            if S["st_ok_since"] < 0.0:
                S["st_ok_since"] = t
        else:
            S["st_ok_since"] = -1.0
        st_hold = S["st_ok_since"] >= 0.0 and t - S["st_ok_since"] >= _EV_END_ST_S - 1e-9
        if S["st_prio"] and st0 >= _ST_PRIO:
            S["st_prio"] = False
        if st0 < _EV_ST_HARD:   # attempt 24 / direction 3: static shortfall during evasion -> static priority
            S["st_prio"] = True
        end_force = (t - S["evade_start"] >= _EVADE_MAX - 1e-9
                     or (S["narrow_end"] >= 0.0 and t >= S["narrow_end"] - 1e-9))
        end_rise = end_still = end_away = False
        if sample:
            far = d_near >= _EARLY_R
            d_prev = S["d_samp"]
            rising = (not prox) and ttc >= _TTC_TRIG and (far or d_near >= d_prev - _EV_INC_TOL)
            if rising:
                if S["inc_since"] < 0.0:
                    S["inc_since"] = t
                    S["inc_d0"] = d_near
            else:
                S["inc_since"] = -1.0
            el = t - S["inc_since"]
            ddot_win = (d_near - S["inc_d0"]) / max(el, _EV_SAMP_DT)
            inc_on = S["inc_since"] >= 0.0
            end_short = el >= _EV_INC_SHORT - 1e-9 and (far or ddot_win > _DDOT_END)
            end_long = el >= _EV_INC_S - 1e-9 and ddot_win > _DDOT_WIN_MIN
            end_rise = inc_on and (end_short or end_long)
            still_m = (not narrow) and (not far) and ttc >= _TTC_NONE and abs(d_near - d_prev) <= _EV_STILL_TOL
            if still_m:
                if S["stat_since"] < 0.0:
                    S["stat_since"] = t
                    S["stat_d0"] = d_near
            else:
                S["stat_since"] = -1.0
            end_still = (S["stat_since"] >= 0.0 and t - S["stat_since"] >= _EV_STILL_S - 1e-9
                         and abs(d_near - S["stat_d0"]) <= _EV_STILL_WIN)
            away = (not prox) and (not narrow) and ttc >= _TTC_TRIG and _movers_receding(anchors, pose)
            if away:
                if S["away_since"] < 0.0:
                    S["away_since"] = t
            else:
                S["away_since"] = -1.0
            end_away = S["away_since"] >= 0.0 and t - S["away_since"] >= _AWAY_S - 1e-9
        normal_ok = (end_rise or end_still or end_away) and st_hold
        if end_force or normal_ok:
            normal = normal_ok
            S["cool_until"] = t + (_EVADE_COOL if normal else _EVADE_FORCE_COOL)
            if not normal:
                S["n_force"] += 1
                print("[C2 debug] evade forced end t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f ttc=%.2f st_n=%.2f st0=%.2f"
                      % (t, x, y, d_near, ttc, st_n, st0), flush=True)
            S["evade_on"] = False
            S["evading"] = False
            S["narrow_end"] = -1.0
            S["inc_since"] = -1.0
            S["stat_since"] = -1.0
            S["away_since"] = -1.0
            S["st_ok_since"] = -1.0
            S["st_prio"] = False
    if sample:
        S["d_samp"] = d_near
        S["samp_t"] = t
    early = S["evading"]

    # slow mode on clr_all with hysteresis (enter < _CLR_GO, leave >= _HYST * _CLR_GO)
    if S["slow"]:
        if st_n >= 0.0 and clr_all >= _CLR_GO * _HYST:
            S["slow"] = False
    elif clr_all < _CLR_GO:
        S["slow"] = True

    # 4) decide
    stop = False
    wide = early and _EV_STOP_HARD <= d_near < _EV_WIDE_D
    cands = _CAND_WIDE if wide else None
    wset = _EV_W_WIDE if wide else None
    band = early and _EV_STOP_HARD <= d_near < _EV_STOP_D and app_own > _PROX_V
    band_still_ok = False
    if band:
        still_long = np.tile(np.array([x, y, yaw], dtype=np.float64), (_KP + 1, 1))[None]
        band_still_ok = _mover_clearance(still_long, P, U)[0] >= _CLR_STOP
    retry = t < S["retry_until"]
    if retry:
        v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"] or st0 < _ST_PRIO, _CAND_WIDE)
    elif early and d_near < _EV_STOP_HARD:
        still_tr = np.tile(np.array([x, y, yaw], dtype=np.float64), (_EV_STILL_KP + 1, 1))[None]
        still_clr = float(_mover_clearance(still_tr, P, U)[0])
        close_still = _closing_speed(P, U, pose, 0.0, _CLOSE_R)   # robot standing: <0 = a mover closes in
        if still_clr < _EV_STILL_CLR:
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"], _CAND_WIDE)
        elif S["stopped"] and close_still < _CLOSE_V:
            S["retry_until"] = t + _STALL_RETRY_S
            S["stall_since"] = -1.0
            S["n_app"] += 1
            print("[C2 debug] approach escape #%d t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f closing=%.2f still_clr=%.2f"
                  % (S["n_app"], t, x, y, d_near, close_still, still_clr), flush=True)
            retry = True
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"] or st0 < _ST_PRIO, _CAND_WIDE)
        else:
            v, w = 0.0, 0.0
            stop = True
    elif band and band_still_ok:
        v, w = 0.0, 0.0      # mover itself approaching 1.0-1.5 m away and standing is safe -> let it pass
        stop = True
    elif early and (wide or st_n < _NARROW_ST):
        lat = _narrow_lateral(pose, P, U, target, anchors, wset)
        if lat is not None:
            v, w = lat
        else:
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"] or st0 < _ST_PRIO, cands)
    elif st_n < 0.0:
        v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, st0 < _ST_PRIO, cands)
    elif early:
        v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, S["st_prio"], cands)
    elif not S["slow"]:
        if clr_all >= _CLR_STOP:
            v, w = v_n, w_n
        else:
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors)
    else:
        v, w, stop, st_block = _slow_cmd(pose, S["idx"], S["v"], clr_all, P, U)
        if stop and (st_block or st0 < _ST_PRIO):
            v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors, True, True)
        elif stop or S["stopped"]:
            closing = _closing_speed(P, U, pose, S["v"], _CLOSE_R)
            hit_still = False
            if stop:
                still_tr = np.tile(np.array([x, y, yaw], dtype=np.float64), (_KP + 1, 1))[None]
                hit_still = _mover_clearance(still_tr, P, U)[0] < _CLR_STOP
            if hit_still or closing < _CLOSE_V:
                v, w, _ = _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchors)

    # standstill for _STALL_S without the mover distance rising -> forced evasion retry
    still_cmd = abs(v) < _STILL_V and abs(w) < _STALL_W
    if still_cmd and not retry:
        if S["stall_since"] < 0.0 or d_near > S["stall_d0"] + _STALL_INC:
            S["stall_since"] = t
            S["stall_d0"] = d_near
        elif t - S["stall_since"] >= _STALL_S - 1e-9:
            S["retry_until"] = t + _STALL_RETRY_S
            S["stall_since"] = -1.0
            S["n_retry"] += 1
            print("[C2 debug] stall retry #%d t=%.2f pos=(%.2f, %.2f) dist=%.2f d0=%.2f"
                  % (S["n_retry"], t, x, y, d_near, S["stall_d0"]), flush=True)
    else:
        S["stall_since"] = -1.0

    _log_evade(t, pose, early, ttc, d_near)
    _log_stop(t, pose, stop, clr_all)
    S["v"], S["w"] = v, w
    return v, w, False


def _choose(pose, P, U, target, anchor=None, evading=False, static_prio=False, cands=None):
    """Pick the (v, w) candidate with the best mover clearance, static-map safety and progress.
    cands: candidate list; default _CAND, _CAND_WIDE when the nearest mover is 1.0-2.0 m away during evasion.
    Attempt 24 / directions 2, 3, 6 (evading=True):
      - mover clearance and static clearance are scored with weights _EV_MV_SC_W : _EV_ST_SC_W = 1 : 2
        (both capped at _EV_SC_CAP m)
      - candidates must keep predicted static clearance stc >= _EV_ST_HARD (0.1 m): tiers
        (clr ok & stc >= 0.1), (stc >= 0.1)
      - when no candidate keeps 0.1 m, static avoidance comes first: only candidates within _EV_ST_FALL_TOL of the
        best stc are allowed (mover-clearance-ok ones preferred among them)
    Distance-rate, anchor and lateral terms are unchanged from attempt 22. Also returns the clearance of standing still."""
    cs = _CAND if cands is None else cands
    trajc = _rollout_cands(pose, _CS["v"], cs)
    clr = _mover_clearance(trajc, P, U)
    stc = _static_clearance(trajc[:, 1:_KS + 1])
    st0 = _pose_static_clearance(pose)
    V = np.array([c[0] for c in cs])
    W = np.array([c[1] for c in cs])
    i0 = cs.index((0.0, 0.0))
    end = trajc[:, -1, :2]
    prog = np.hypot(end[:, 0] - target[0], end[:, 1] - target[1])
    score = (10.0 * np.minimum(clr, 1.0) - 0.5 * prog
             - 0.3 * (np.abs(V - _CS["v"]) + 0.3 * np.abs(W - _CS["w"]))
             + 5.0 * np.minimum(stc, 0.0))
    if evading:
        # attempt 24 / direction 6: mover : static clearance weights 1 : 2
        score = score + (_EV_MV_SC_W - 10.0) * np.minimum(clr, _EV_SC_CAP)
        score = score + _EV_ST_SC_W * np.clip(stc, 0.0, _EV_SC_CAP)
        if static_prio:
            sc = np.clip(stc, 0.0, _ST_SAFE) / _ST_SAFE
            score = score + _EV_ST_F * _ST_PRIO_W * sc
            kl = max(1, min(_ANCHOR_K, trajc.shape[1] - 1))
            c0, s0 = math.cos(float(pose[2])), math.sin(float(pose[2]))
            lat = np.abs(-s0 * (trajc[:, kl, 0] - float(pose[0])) + c0 * (trajc[:, kl, 1] - float(pose[1])))
            st_link = np.clip(stc / _EV_ST_REQ, 0.0, 1.0)
            score = score + _LAT_PRIO_W * np.minimum(lat / 0.5, 1.0) * st_link
    A = None
    if anchor is not None:
        A = np.asarray(anchor, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 4)
        if A.shape[0] == 0:
            A = None
    if A is not None:
        k = max(1, min(_ANCHOR_K, trajc.shape[1] - 1))
        ts = np.arange(k + 1) * _DTP
        mx = A[:, 0][None, :] + A[:, 2][None, :] * ts[:, None]
        my = A[:, 1][None, :] + A[:, 3][None, :] * ts[:, None]
        off = 0.5 * (_BODY[0] + _BODY[1])
        bx = trajc[:, :k + 1, 0] + off * np.cos(trajc[:, :k + 1, 2])
        by = trajc[:, :k + 1, 1] + off * np.sin(trajc[:, :k + 1, 2])
        dd = np.hypot(bx[:, :, None] - mx[None, :, :], by[:, :, None] - my[None, :, :])
        da = dd.min(axis=1)
        score = score - 20.0 * np.maximum(_ANCHOR_R - da, 0.0).sum(axis=1)
        vcx = (bx[:, k] - bx[:, k - 1]) / _DTP
        vcy = (by[:, k] - by[:, k - 1]) / _DTP
        sx = mx[k][None, :] - bx[:, k][:, None]
        sy = my[k][None, :] - by[:, k][:, None]
        sd = np.maximum(np.hypot(sx, sy), 1e-3)
        rate = (sx * (A[:, 2][None, :] - vcx[:, None]) + sy * (A[:, 3][None, :] - vcy[:, None])) / sd
        near = sd < _REL_R
        score = score - _REL_W * (np.maximum(-rate, 0.0) * near).max(axis=1)
        cx0, cy0 = float(bx[0, 0]), float(by[0, 0])
        j = int(np.argmin(np.hypot(A[:, 0] - cx0, A[:, 1] - cy0)))
        b = math.atan2(A[j, 1] - cy0, A[j, 0] - cx0)
        dx = bx[:, k] - cx0
        dy = by[:, k] - cy0
        dl = np.hypot(dx, dy)
        ang = np.arctan2(dy, dx) - b
        dev = np.abs(np.arctan2(np.sin(ang), np.cos(ang)))
        score = score + _LAT_W * 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(dev)) * np.minimum(dl / 0.5, 1.0)
        if evading:
            ddc = _cand_ddot(trajc, A)
            if ddc is not None:
                score = score + _ddot_score(ddc, V, W)
            vjx, vjy = float(A[j, 2]), float(A[j, 3])
            spj = math.hypot(vjx, vjy)
            if spj >= _PERP_MIN_V:
                nx, ny = -vjy / spj, vjx / spj
                side = nx * (cx0 - float(A[j, 0])) + ny * (cy0 - float(A[j, 1]))
                sgn = 1.0 if side >= 0.0 else -1.0
                off_line = sgn * (nx * dx + ny * dy)
                score = score + _VEL_LAT_W * np.clip(off_line / 0.5, -1.0, 1.0)
            rx, ry = cx0 - float(A[j, 0]), cy0 - float(A[j, 1])
            rd = max(math.hypot(rx, ry), 1e-3)
            yaw0 = float(pose[2])
            v0 = float(_CS["v"])
            close = (rx * (vjx - v0 * math.cos(yaw0)) + ry * (vjy - v0 * math.sin(yaw0))) / rd
            if close > 0.0:
                if spj >= _PERP_MIN_V:
                    hd = math.atan2(vjx, -vjy)
                    if rx * math.cos(hd) + ry * math.sin(hd) < 0.0:
                        hd += math.pi
                else:
                    hd = math.atan2(ry, rx)
                mang = np.arctan2(dy, dx)
                score = score + _LAT_PRIO_W * np.cos(mang - hd) * np.minimum(dl / 0.5, 1.0)
    if evading:
        ok_clr = clr >= _CLR_GO * _EV_CLR_MIN_F
        st_ok = stc >= _EV_ST_HARD                       # attempt 24 / direction 2: required during evasion
        tiers = (ok_clr & st_ok, st_ok)
        for allowed in tiers:
            if np.any(allowed):
                i = int(np.argmax(np.where(allowed, score, -np.inf)))
                i = _no_spin(i, V, W, clr, stc, score, _EV_ST_HARD)
                return float(V[i]), float(W[i]), float(clr[i0])
        # attempt 24 / direction 3: no candidate keeps 0.1 m -> static avoidance before mover avoidance
        allowed = stc >= float(stc.max()) - _EV_ST_FALL_TOL
        pref = allowed & ok_clr
        if np.any(pref):
            allowed = pref
        score = score + 20.0 * (stc - st0)
        i = int(np.argmax(np.where(allowed, score, -np.inf)))
        return float(V[i]), float(W[i]), float(clr[i0])
    allowed = stc >= 0.0
    if not np.any(allowed):
        allowed = stc >= min(st0, 0.0) - 0.005
        score = score + 20.0 * (stc - st0)
    if not np.any(allowed):
        i = int(np.argmax(stc))
    else:
        i = int(np.argmax(np.where(allowed, score, -np.inf)))
        i = _no_spin(i, V, W, clr, stc, score)
    return float(V[i]), float(W[i]), float(clr[i0])


def _narrow_lateral(pose, P, U, target, anchors, wset=None):
    """During evasion in a narrow static zone keep the current speed (0.5 m/s when stopped) and pick the yaw rate
    (from wset, default _NARROW_W; _EV_W_WIDE when the nearest mover is 1.0-2.0 m away) that moves the robot
    sideways / away from the nearest mover. Attempt 24 / directions 2, 6: only candidates with static clearance
    >= _EV_ST_HARD (0.1 m) and mover clearance >= 0.9 * _CLR_GO are allowed, and mover : static clearance are
    scored 1 : 2; returns None when none is allowed (the caller then falls back to _choose, static-first)."""
    v0 = float(_CS["v"])
    vk = v0 if abs(v0) >= _STILL_V else _FWD_V
    W = np.array(_NARROW_W if wset is None else wset, dtype=np.float64)
    V = np.full(W.size, vk)
    tr = _rollout_vw(pose, v0, V, W)
    clr = _mover_clearance(tr, P, U)
    stc = _static_clearance(tr[:, 1:_KS + 1])
    ok = (stc >= _EV_ST_HARD) & (clr >= _CLR_GO * _EV_CLR_MIN_F)
    if not np.any(ok):
        return None
    x0, y0, yaw0 = float(pose[0]), float(pose[1]), float(pose[2])
    k = max(1, min(_ANCHOR_K, _KP))
    dx = tr[:, k, 0] - x0
    dy = tr[:, k, 1] - y0
    c0, s0 = math.cos(yaw0), math.sin(yaw0)
    lat = np.abs(-s0 * dx + c0 * dy)
    bonus = _LAT_PRIO_W * np.minimum(lat / 0.5, 1.0)
    A = np.asarray(anchors, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 4) if anchors is not None else np.zeros((0, 4))
    if A.shape[0] > 0:
        j = int(np.argmin(np.hypot(A[:, 0] - x0, A[:, 1] - y0)))
        b = math.atan2(A[j, 1] - y0, A[j, 0] - x0)
        ang = np.arctan2(dy, dx) - b
        dev = np.abs(np.arctan2(np.sin(ang), np.cos(ang)))
        dl = np.hypot(dx, dy)
        bonus = bonus + _LAT_W * 0.5 * (1.0 - np.cos(dev)) * np.minimum(dl / 0.5, 1.0)
        ddc = _cand_ddot(tr, A)
        if ddc is not None:
            bonus = bonus + _ddot_score(ddc, V, W)
    end = tr[:, -1, :2]
    prog = np.hypot(end[:, 0] - target[0], end[:, 1] - target[1])
    score = (_EV_MV_SC_W * np.minimum(clr, _EV_SC_CAP) + bonus - 0.5 * prog
             + _EV_ST_SC_W * np.clip(stc, 0.0, _EV_SC_CAP)
             - 0.1 * np.abs(W - float(_CS["w"])))
    i = int(np.argmax(np.where(ok, score, -np.inf)))
    return float(V[i]), float(W[i])


def _no_spin(i, V, W, clr, stc, score, st_min=0.0):
    """Direction 5: if candidate i is an in-place command (|v| < _STILL_V: turning on the spot or standing still),
    replace it by a _FWD_V forward candidate (same w preferred) with stc >= st_min (attempt 24: _EV_ST_HARD during
    evasion, 0.0 otherwise), clr >= 0.9 * _CLR_GO and at most _FWD_CLR_D less mover clearance; otherwise keep i."""
    if abs(V[i]) >= _STILL_V:
        return i
    fwd = ((np.abs(V - _FWD_V) < 1e-9) & (stc >= st_min)
           & (clr >= max(_CLR_GO * _EV_CLR_MIN_F, float(clr[i]) - _FWD_CLR_D)))
    if not np.any(fwd):
        return i
    same = fwd & (np.abs(W - W[i]) < 1e-9)
    if np.any(same):
        return int(np.argmax(same))
    return int(np.argmax(np.where(fwd, score, -np.inf)))
```
